channel_conventions.deck_c_d: status 0x93 / 0x94 (0xB3/0xB4, 0xE3/0xE4) = MIDI ch 4 / 5, layer deck_cd (DECK3/DECK4 toggled)
channel_conventions.mixer_strips: strip n uses status 0x9n / 0xBn (ch1..4 = MIDI ch 2..5)
channel_conventions.shift: +SHIFT rows are separate codes on the same channel
channel_conventions.pads: Blue pad mode; Red and Violet in footnotes.md

controls.name: l_deck3
controls.notes: L-DECK3 note (same code in DECK-C/D column) [l_deck3]

controls.name: l_deck3_cd
controls.notes: DECK-C/D column L-DECK3 note (same code in DECK-C/D column) [l_deck3]

controls.name: l_beats
controls.notes: L-BEATS relative encoder (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); push note 0x25 (shift 0x65) [l_beats]

controls.name: l_beats_shift
controls.notes: +SHIFT L-BEATS relative encoder (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); push note 0x25 (shift 0x65) [l_beats]

controls.name: l_beats_cd
controls.notes: DECK-C/D column L-BEATS relative encoder (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); push note 0x25 (shift 0x65) [l_beats]

controls.name: l_beats_cd_shift
controls.notes: DECK-C/D column +SHIFT L-BEATS relative encoder (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); push note 0x25 (shift 0x65) [l_beats]

controls.name: l_wheel_cd
controls.notes: DECK-C/D column L-WHEEL relative (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); touch note 0x3F (shift 0x7F) [l_jog]

controls.name: l_wheel_cd_shift
controls.notes: DECK-C/D column +SHIFT L-WHEEL relative (CW 0x01.., CCW 0x7F..); touch note 0x3F (shift 0x7F) [l_jog]
